FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Art Lane, Suite 567, Creative City, CA 90210-1234
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Canvas & Color Art Supplies operates as a vibrant art supply store dedicated to providing a wide range of high-quality art materials to both professional and aspiring artists. Our core operations include sourcing top-tier products from reputable suppliers, maintaining a well-organized inventory management system to keep track of our art supplies, and conducting regular reviews to ensure compliance with industry standards. We prioritize safety by implementing protocols for handling any hazardous materials and ensure our employees are trained in customer service and loss prevention techniques. Additionally, we embrace digital sales channels while maintaining robust cybersecurity measures to protect our customers’ information. Overall, our goal is to foster a creative environment where artists can find everything they need to express their creativity while ensuring a safe and compliant operational framework.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any restricted activities and confirms that we maintain professionally appraised inventories that are updated annually. Additionally, we have implemented robust fire and water protection systems, including sprinklers, and document our inventory management practices as required. Furthermore, enhanced security measures are in place to safeguard our high-value inventory.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Creative Canvas Co. - An online art supply store focusing on eco-friendly products and artistic workshops.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2023, a water leak occurred due to a faulty sprinkler system, resulting in damage to inventory valued at $1,500. The claim is ongoing and currently under review with the insurance company. Additionally, on 11/22/2022, we suffered a theft incident where artworks worth $500 were stolen. The case has been resolved, and security measures have since been enhanced.
